subject: planner: stop pushing Agg down through Projection if substitution fail (#50932)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in `pkg/planner/core/rule_aggregation_push_down.go` and `pkg/expression/util.go`. The change switches agg-pushdown-across-projection to use `expression.ColumnSubstituteImpl(..., fail1Return=true)` and bails out when substitution reports fallback (`failed==true`), preventing invalid plan rewrites when projection-column substitution can’t be safely performed (regression test added for #50926). No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues found in the touched planner/expression logic; later history up to `upstream/master` shows subsequent refactors/related work but no follow-up fix indicating a regression from this commit.
